name: Draft System
description: Manage availability request draft rounds with priority-based time slots
features: Create new draft rounds for academic years
Configure window size and slot duration
Manage draft lifecycle (not_started, active, paused, completed)
Track faculty priority order and slot assignments
Monitor submission status (submitted, active, waiting, expired)
Send notifications to faculty when slots open
Automatically advance to next slot when current expires
use_cases: Ensuring fair priority order for unavailability requests
Tracking who has submitted availability requests
Handling expired slots and deadline enforcement
api_endpoints: GET /api/admin/draft/slots - Get all draft slots with status
POST /api/admin/draft/check-expired - Check and advance expired slots

draft_states.not_started: Draft created but not yet started

slot_states.active: Current slot open, faculty can submit

configuration.window_size: Number of hours faculty have to submit (e.g., 48)

workflow: 1. Create draft: Set year, window size, hours per slot
2. System assigns priority order to all faculty
5. Faculty submits availability or slot expires
notes: Priority order randomized or based on previous year equity
Expired slots can be manually checked and advanced
Faculty cannot submit after their slot expires
Draft must be active for faculty to see submission form
